scripts.dev: concurrently "cd apps/backend && npm run start:dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev" "cd apps/mock-api && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/api-contract && npm run build --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix apps/mock-api
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/backend && npm run lint && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run lint && npm run build && cd ../mock-api && npm run typecheck
